Return a full 1024x1536 genuine RGBA PNG, mostly empty transparent space, with ONLY the specified part at the specified master coordinates. No labels, diagram, frame, background, shadow, halo or RGB wash showing through alpha. Opaque paint inside shape; clean narrow antialiased outline. No stray fragments.
